overviewParagraphs: Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club offers something genuinely rare in Asian golf tourism — an authentic rural experience where the course setting is as much the attraction as the game itself. Set among traditional Cambodian rice paddies and mature coconut palm groves near Phnom Penh's international airport, this course provides a window into the agricultural heart of Cambodia that no museum or city tour can replicate, all delivered from the seat of a golf cart with a caddie at your side.

The course design respects its rural environment — the routing works with the existing landscape features rather than imposing artificial drama, creating a natural, unhurried flow around the 18 holes that encourages taking in the surrounding fields, palms, and the peaceful sounds of rural Cambodian life. Water features from the rice paddy irrigation system are integrated into the layout, and the greens are consistently well-maintained despite the relatively modest green fee schedule.

For discerning golfers landing in Phnom Penh and looking for an immediate, accessible, and genuinely memorable first round, AGS often recommends Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club as the arrival-day option — close to the airport, no transport stress, and a culturally immersive experience that sets the tone perfectly for what Cambodia golf has to offer beyond its city-centre venues.

curatorBriefHtml: Royal Cambodia Phnom Penh Golf Club (opened 1999 by P+Z Development, just 25 minutes west of central Phnom Penh) is Cambodia’s historic original golf club — a tranquil, unhurried parkland course surrounded by working rice paddies, swaying sugar palms, and peaceful rural villages. Measuring 6,538 yards from the Blue Tees (Par 72), the flat, walking-friendly layout prioritizes relaxed enjoyment over penal championship difficulty.

While Vattanac, Chhun On, and Garden City headline Phnom Penh’s modern luxury golf tier, Royal Phnom Penh offers authentic old-school Cambodian charm and easy playability — well suited as a gentle arrival-day warm-up round or for golfers who love nostalgic countryside clubhouses.
AGS slots Royal Phnom Penh into extended Phnom Penh itineraries alongside Vattanac Golf Resort and Garden City.

scorecard.verdict: One of Cambodia's classic original layouts. Flat, walkable fairways lined with mature coconut palms and native floral beds provide an authentic and relaxing round of golf.

faqs.q: What is the atmosphere like at Royal Cambodia Phnom Penh Golf Club?
faqs.a: Opened in 1999, it is Cambodia’s original golf club — relaxed, peaceful, and framed by authentic rice paddies and towering coconut palms rather than modern residential towers.

faqs.q: Is Royal Phnom Penh suitable for higher-handicap golfers?
faqs.a: Yes — flat terrain, wide fairways, and minimal forced carries make it Phnom Penh’s gentlest, most forgiving 18-hole round.

faqs.q: How far is Royal Phnom Penh from central Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Roughly 25 to 35 minutes west of central Phnom Penh via private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: When is the best time of year to play Royal Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: November through March offers dry, pleasant morning temperatures across Phnom Penh.
